name: Iris Arcadia
original_name: イリス・アルケーディア
source:
Princess General of the Kingdom of Aurelia, known as the Sacred Kingdom. She is a peerless general, whether she is wielding a sword or leading an army. Never conceited, she is a compassionate woman who is devoted to the well-being of her people. Therefore, she is strongly opposed to the country of service. 
She has a strong bond with Serafina, the symbol of the Holy Kingdom, and although Iris is usually wise beyond her years, she can be honest in front of her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1014490]Getchu[/url]]
